correctness.rationale: Beta(1,1) posterior threshold is u-v>=0, so a run ends at a first passage to -1. Catalan ballot counting gives f_p(z). Renewal equations G_A=s_a+f_a G_B and G_B=s_b+f_b G_A give the defective PGFs and exact majority-lock region. At a=1/2, expansion f(z)=1-sqrt(2(1-z))+O(1-z) and monotone Tauberian transfer yield the t^-1/2 tail constants and infinite mean. Independently checked algebraic win formula and exact (7/10,9/10)->3/5 witness; source checker inspected, but no infinite-time numerical certification is claimed.
